description: Turkmenistan's statistics committee publishes the results of the 2022 Population and Housing Census as eleven chapter PDFs in Turkmen, Russian and English. Chapter ten, on the housing stock, gives 1,344,268 dwellings nationally with floor area and residents, and counts residential buildings by period built, from before 1951 to 2021 and later, for Ashgabat, each velayat and every city and etrap within it, with a second series by outer wall material. Further tables cover dwellings by ownership, type and amenities. Chapter eleven, on housing conditions, counts households with electricity and with network or liquefied gas by region, then heating, hot water, water supply and drinking water sources, sewerage and toilets, kitchens and bathrooms, and internet access, split urban and rural. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF downloads, no registration. Licence: no licence statement was found. Caveats: tables are PDF layout and must be transcribed; amenity tables are by region, not etrap. Simulation uses: building age and wall material by etrap for earthquake exposure, and gas and heating supply by region for winter energy planning. Related records: IPUMS International.
